generation.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: premium 16:9 outer presentation background plate for real ShellX desktop screenshots
Primary request: an elegant near-black midnight-blue abstract environment with flowing topographic contour lines and restrained luminous energy currents that frame a completely quiet central rectangle
Scene/backdrop: deep black-navy field, subtle dimensional haze, soft electric-cyan illumination near opposite outer corners, one very restrained warm amber accent along a distant contour
Style/medium: sophisticated cinematic abstract digital art, premium developer-tool campaign aesthetic, crisp and understated
Composition/framing: exact 16:9 horizontal; generous empty low-contrast central presentation area occupying roughly 82% width and 88% height; visual energy confined to the outer perimeter so a real application screenshot remains readable
Lighting/mood: refined, technical, confident, dark, high-end; subtle depth without distracting glare
Color palette: near-black, midnight navy, indigo, electric cyan, tiny warm amber accent
Constraints: background plate only; absolutely no application UI, no browser chrome, no windows, no devices, no text, no letters, no logos, no icons, no badges, no mock interface elements, no watermark
Avoid: bright center, busy particles, generic neon tunnel, cyberpunk city, gradients that reduce screenshot contrast

content.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: wide landscape artwork to be visibly opened as user content inside the real ShellX Preview Center
Primary request: a breathtaking photorealistic snow leopard standing on a rain-dark basalt ridge above a vast alpine valley at blue hour, with luminous aurora-like cyan clouds and a restrained warm amber sunrise breaking through distant peaks
Scene/backdrop: sweeping high-altitude wilderness, mist layers, wet rock, distant waterfalls, dramatic but believable weather
Subject: one majestic snow leopard, full body, sharply detailed natural fur, calm alert gaze, anatomically realistic
Style/medium: premium cinematic wildlife photography, photorealistic, editorial quality
Composition/framing: 16:9 horizontal, animal slightly off-center with strong depth and readable silhouette, no cropped paws or tail, visually striking at desktop-preview size
Lighting/mood: high contrast cyan-blue atmosphere with a focused warm amber rim light, awe-inspiring and refined rather than fantasy kitsch
Materials/textures: realistic wet basalt, fine fur, drifting mist, snow crystals
Constraints: image content only; no application interface, no windows, no devices, no text, no letters, no logos, no badges, no watermark
Avoid: extra animals, artificial neon outlines, oversaturation, cartoon styling, malformed anatomy

generation.uiPolicy: Generated pixels are restricted to the outer presentation backdrop and the snow-leopard image visibly opened as user content inside the real installed ShellX Preview Center. No generated or retouched pixels replace ShellX controls, chrome, labels, or layout.
generation.compositionPolicy: Product sources are uniformly resized to 1280x800 and placed at +128+16 on the 1536x864 presentation plate. The Browser source combines exact installed chrome with the live same-URL Windows page viewport cropped at +10+213 and placed at +0+168 inside the measured native engine bounds.
